'''FC Samtredia''' ({{lang-ka|სკ სამტრედია}}), commonly known as '''Samtredia''', is a [[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] professional [[association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Samtredia]]. The club competes in [[Erovnuli Liga 2]], the 2nd tier of [[Football in Georgia (country)|Georgian football]]. Their home ground is the [[Erosi Manjgaladze Stadium]].

In [[2016 Umaglesi Liga|2016]], Samtredia won the league and the [[Georgian Super Cup|Super Cup]]."}}
